checks.title: Lifecycle artifact set exists
checks.rationale: FIND-32 cross-artifact consistency blind spot. Verifies task / plan / decision / verify / status all exist for the target task.

checks.title: Evidence Refs exist and match required format
checks.rationale: FIND-32. Verifies the verify artifact's '## Evidence Refs' section is non-empty and that referenced repo-relative paths exist on disk; flags malformed or absolute refs.

checks.title: Canonical owner and reviewer references
checks.rationale: FIND-32. Verifies status owner and final_approver references against the canonical reviewer set; missing registry yields explicit reason_code rather than silent pass.

checks.title: Review timestamp follows evidence generation timestamp
checks.rationale: FIND-32. When both review_timestamp and evidence_generated_at are present, asserts review_timestamp > evidence_generated_at. Missing timestamps return skipped_with_reason_code, never silent pass.

excluded_checks.title: AC-to-verify coverage
excluded_checks.reason: Deferred to v3.5.1 after the four structural checks stabilize. v3.5.0 does NOT implement AC-to-verify coverage.

excluded_checks.title: Reasoning faithfulness score
excluded_checks.reason: Forbidden in v3.5.0 PCACC. PCACC v3.5.0 is a structural check, not a reasoning audit.

excluded_checks.title: Belief-state audit
excluded_checks.reason: Forbidden in v3.5.0 PCACC. Hidden belief state is out of structural-check scope.

excluded_checks.title: Model self-confidence audit
excluded_checks.reason: Forbidden in v3.5.0 PCACC. Self-reported model confidence is not deterministic governance evidence.

excluded_checks.title: Free-text rationale field
excluded_checks.reason: Forbidden in v3.5.0 PCACC output. Each check entry uses structured fields only.

excluded_checks.title: Markdown SAVeR report
excluded_checks.reason: Forbidden in v3.5.0 PCACC output. PCACC output is JSON only; markdown narrative reports are not authoritative.

limitations: PCACC v3.5.0 is structural only; it does not verify reasoning faithfulness, hidden belief state, or model self-confidence.
PCACC detects violations but does not resolve them; resolution flows through the existing decision artifact workflow.
AC-to-verify coverage is deferred to v3.5.1; PCACC-DEFERRED-AC-COVERAGE in excluded_checks records the deferral.
PCACC-003 canonical reviewer set is conservative; expansion requires a future task lifecycle with explicit decision artifact authorization (no global model-brand-to-role binding per v3.5 plan §5.3).
PCACC-004 timestamp comparison uses ISO 8601 lexicographic order on Asia/Taipei dates; missing or malformed timestamps return skipped_with_reason_code with explicit reason_code.
PCACC does not perform validator module split (FIND-30, deferred to v3.5.1 / v3.6) and does not extract a policy registry (deferred to v3.5.1 / v3.6).
PCACC does not authorize TASK-1027 Artifact Obligation Matrix; that surface is owned by a separate task lifecycle.
non_authorization: TASK-1026 only authorizes the four strict structural PCACC checks above. It does NOT authorize executing TASK-1027, implementing Artifact Obligation Matrix, AC-to-verify coverage, reasoning-faithfulness audit, belief-state audit, model self-confidence audit, free-text rationale, markdown SAVeR report, validator module split, policy registry extraction, ruff strict enforcement, FIND-18 Mitigated declaration, waiver registry creation, or style debt registry creation.
